name: After a day away, a wish for a pet, and a stroke gives it
case: The person comes back after more than a day away, opens claude, and doesn't touch or talk to Boop, which turns lonely. It has wished for a pet. The person strokes it, which meets the wish at once, and Boop is lonely no more: happy or comfy.
why: asks.md's [wish pet]: offered at an idle check-in; Pipeline.gesture meets it (Core.meetWish); mood/lonely.md: a stroke ends it at once
